reasoning: the requested action and its argument are stated directly in the query

tools.description: Answer a factual or explanatory question that needs no live research or screen context.
tools.name: answer_knowledge

tools.description: Research a topic using current external sources when the user explicitly asks to research, investigate, or find current information.
tools.name: research_topic

tools.description: Describe or explain what is currently visible on the user's screen without taking an action.
tools.name: describe_screen

tools.description: Perform a specific, non-destructive action in the visible user interface.
tools.name: perform_screen_action

tools.description: Perform a specific non-destructive file creation, copy, move, or organization task.
tools.name: perform_file_operation

tools.description: Route a request that needs the larger phone model because it requires broad synthesis or richer generation, but no screen action.
tools.name: route_to_phone_model

tools.description: Ask the user for a missing required detail or to resolve an ambiguous reference before any action is taken.
tools.name: ask_clarification

tools.description: Request explicit confirmation before deleting, erasing, overwriting, uninstalling, force-quitting, or discarding user data.
tools.name: confirm_destructive_action
